name: Purpose and theory underpin the experiment
description: G6 makes its theoretical purpose explicit without preloading algorithms into the workspace.
steps: Open ÀTÚNBÍ
Inspect the purpose and BARE theory section
Verify the network initially has no algorithms
Click Run controlled experiment with the empty workspace
expected: Purpose, hypotheses and G6 controls are present. No simulation is run when no algorithms exist and a warning explains that algorithms must first be installed.

name: Connected versus ablated trajectories produce measurable evidence
description: Paired comparison starts from matched algorithm states and reports causal sensitivity without claiming proof of emergence.
steps: Click Load example
In the G6 workbench leave All connections selected and 24 ticks
Click Run controlled experiment
Inspect trajectory graph, final divergence, spatial gradient delta and interpretation
expected: A divergence chart with 24 ticks appears and shows nonzero peak divergence, paired measurements, and a cautious interpretation that does not assert scientifically proven emergence.

name: Ablating a different relationship class changes evidence
description: The operator can compare separately disabling internal and external relationships.
steps: Click Load example
Choose Internal connections only and run controlled experiment
Choose External connections only and run controlled experiment
Compare peak divergence and final spatial gradient delta
expected: The experiment panel accepts both interventions and updates its trajectory and measurement results without changing the live node graph.

name: Zero coupling is a valid negative experimental control
description: When all relationships are disabled, connected and ablated runs are identical.
steps: Click Load example
Uncheck Active for all inner relationships in each environment
Uncheck Active on the external relationship
Choose All connections and run a 10-tick experiment
expected: Peak divergence is 0.0000, there is no interaction detected and Candidate pattern reads NOT ESTABLISHED.

name: Export a reproducible G6 evidence record
description: Evidence export must contain the paired experiment configuration and complete observations.
steps: Click Load example
Run a 10-tick controlled experiment
Click Export evidence JSON
Inspect downloaded file
expected: A JSON evidence file is downloaded containing BARE v1.0 theory, the initial algorithm states and relationships, the chosen ablation, ten observation records and an explicit interpretation.
